champions.rationale: Operator-designated action champion (2026-09-01): action prior .88 at 0.09 USD/s, and the platform's only live-proven route.
Operator-designated fallback: the registry's highest action (.93) and physics (.92) priors, at a higher rate.
Highest physical-plausibility prior (.92) in the registry; Wan 2.1's public .939 physics score is version-mismatched evidence and deliberately not a prior.
Physics .90 with the strongest render prior among priced routes (.92; flow-veo-3.1's .94 has no verified price) as the second opinion.
Operator-designated dialogue champion (2026-09-01): native synced audio on the full-quality variant.
Operator-designated fallback: dialogue prior .88, multi-reference support for multi-character dialogue, and the FREE-tier route.
ByteDance-native Chinese-dialogue lineage; the Seedance 2.0 Chinese-dialogue benchmark evidence is recorded as a near-miss version, so this stays judgement, not a measured prior.
Chinese-ecosystem model with the registry's highest text-render prior (.84).
Highest text-render prior (.84).
Text prior .82 at a lower rate; same transport, so this is a quality/cost step, not a provider-outage hedge.

Operator-designated start/end-frame champion (2026-09-01): documented first+last-frame material combination in I2V and frame conditioning in R2V. Its priors are all initial 0.5, so open scoring would never pick it — this entry is the correction a manual table exists to make.
Operator-designated fallback: declares start_end with the highest identity prior across the transition.
Identity prior .90 with 4-reference support.
Native R2V mode with 5 reference assets; takes the shots whose reference count exceeds Kling's 4.
Highest identity prior (.90).
Identity .82 with 4-reference support at 0.09 USD/s on the live-proven transport.
Camera prior .90 at the lowest rate in the .90 tier.
Camera .90 with the strongest render prior among priced routes (.92).
Highest render prior (.92) among priced routes for product surfaces; flow-veo-3.1 renders better on paper but has no verified price and cannot quote.
Render .88 with the best text prior, for packshots carrying on-frame copy.
Balanced priors at 0.09 USD/s; the platform's live-proven default.
Near-flagship priors at 0.10 USD/s; the only video model here with exact-version public benchmark backing (OSCBench).
